title: Functional connectomics reveals general wiring rule in mouse visual cortex
primary_outputs: Like-to-like wiring relationships with anatomical/projection controls from per-neuron and per-edge measurements.
Common-input versus functional-similarity relationships and GLMM/bootstrap sensitivity.

lineage_and_loader_evidence.assessment: Same Nature s41586-025-08840-3 paper has two observed code contracts: readiness bc9302a… explicitly reads edge_data_v1.pkl/node_data_v1.pkl from public BossDBv1; later audit tagv1.1.0 commit9005c2d… expects unresolved edge_data.feather. The pickle route is independently identified, not proof of Feather equivalence.
